from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,json,re,hashlib,concurrent.futures,os,shlex
root=Path.cwd();logs=root/'target/lua-native-hooks/capi-validation-final';logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
fixture=root/'crates/deadlib-lua/tests/native-boundary'
files=sorted({p for p in (root/'crates/deadlib-lua').rglob('*')if p.suffix in {'.rs','.c','.h'}}|set(fixture.iterdir())|{root/'crates/deadlib-lua/Cargo.toml',root/'scripts/check_rust_lua_native_boundary.py',root/'Cargo.toml',root/'Cargo.lock',root/'.cargo/config.toml',root/'crates/deadlib-lua/capi/Cargo.toml',root/'scripts/build_rust_lua_c_api.py',root/'scripts/check_rust_lua_c_api.py',root/'crates/deadlib-lua/capi/tests/capi-host.expected'})
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def hashes():return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix():sha(p)for p in files if p.is_file()}
before=hashes();linux='/home/perfecttaste/.cache/deadlua-native-context/1793130712142473700'
def run(name,cmd):
 start=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,capture_output=True);log=logs/(name+'.log');log.write_bytes(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 s=(p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace');groups=[dict(passed=int(a),failed=int(b),ignored=int(c))for a,b,c in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored',s)]
 result=dict(name=name,command=cmd,returncode=p.returncode,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,log=str(log),log_sha256=sha(log),test_groups=groups,passed=sum(g['passed']for g in groups))
 print(name,p.returncode,result['passed'],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:print(s[-3500:],flush=True)
 return result
def suite(platform):
 cmds=[('tests',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','-p','deadlib-lua-capi','--no-fail-fast']),('no-default-features',['cargo','check','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--no-default-features','--all-targets']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','-p','deadlib-lua-capi','--all-targets','--no-deps','--','-D','warnings'])]
 if platform=='windows':
  cmds += [('fmt',['cargo','fmt','-p','deadlib-lua','-p','deadlib-lua-capi','--','--check']),('dependencies',['cargo','tree','--locked','-p','deadlib-lua','--edges','normal,build'])]
  return [run(platform+'-'+n,c[:2]+['--target-dir','target/lua-native-hooks']+c[2:] if n in ('tests','clippy','no-default-features') else c)for n,c in cmds]
 result=[]
 for name,cmd in cmds:
  env=['CARGO_TARGET_DIR='+linux+('/native'if platform=='linux-x64'else'/i686')]
  if platform=='linux-i686':
   cmd=cmd[:2]+['--target','i686-unknown-linux-gnu']+cmd[2:];env+=['CFLAGS_i686_unknown_linux_gnu=-msse2 -mfpmath=sse']
  shell='exec env '+' '.join(shlex.quote(x)for x in env+cmd)+' 2>&1'
  result.append(run(platform+'-'+name,['wsl.exe','-d','Debian','--cd',str(root),'--','sh','-lc',shell]))
 return result
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3)as pool:runs=[r for group in pool.map(suite,['windows','linux-x64','linux-i686'])for r in group]
result=dict(source_hashes=before,runs=runs,linux_target_root=linux,sources_unchanged=before==hashes())
(root/'docs/testing/2026-10-29-rust-lua-capi-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('sources unchanged',result['sources_unchanged'],flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if result['sources_unchanged']and all(r['returncode']==0 for r in runs)else 1)

from pathlib import Path

 else:assert p.returncode==0,(kind,p.returncode)

verify-capi-i686.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
r=Path.cwd();p=r/'docs/testing/2026-10-29-rust-lua-capi-i686.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text());sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name,h in d['source_hashes'].items():assert sha(r/name)==h,name
elfs=set()
def artifact(name,h):
 path=Path(name);assert sha(path)==h,name
 if path.read_bytes()[:4]==b'\x7fELF':
  assert path.read_bytes()[4]==1 and'ELF32'in subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-h',str(path)],text=True);elfs.add(name)
for name,h in d['artifacts'].items():artifact(name,h)
mp=Path(d['package_manifest']);assert sha(mp)==d['package_manifest_sha256'];m=json.loads(mp.read_text())
for name,h in m['payload_hashes'].items():artifact(str(mp.parent/name),h)
for name,target in m['symlinks'].items():assert (mp.parent/name).is_symlink()and str((mp.parent/name).readlink())==target
assert m['target']=='i686-unknown-linux-gnu'and m['profile']=='release'and len(d['forwarded_entries'])==133 and set(d['forwarded_entries'])==set(m['generated_exports'])
dynamic=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-d',m['runtime']],text=True)
assert 'Library soname: [liblua5.1.so.0]'in dynamic
needed=re.findall(r'\(NEEDED\).*?\[(.*?)\]',dynamic);assert not any('lua'in name.lower()for name in needed),needed
expected=(r/'crates/deadlib-lua/capi/tests/capi-host.expected').read_text().splitlines();assert len(expected)==97
for engine,row in d['runs'].items():
 assert row['returncode']==0 and row['stdout'].splitlines()==expected
 if engine=='rust':assert re.fullmatch(r'CAPI operations=\d+ states=6 groups=5 libraries=1\n',row['stderr'])
 else:assert not row['stderr']
 assert d['cli_runs'][engine]['returncode']==0 and d['cli_runs'][engine]['stdout']=='standalone-cli-ok\tmain\n'and not d['cli_runs'][engine]['stderr']
for symbol in ['owned_default_panic','owned_returning_panic']:
 rows=[d['terminating'][engine][symbol]for engine in d['runs']];assert all(row['returncode']==1 for row in rows)and len({(row['stdout'],row['stderr'])for row in rows})==1
assert d['no_rust_bootstrap']and d['no_public_forwarding_frames']and d['observations_equal']and not d['internal_test_module']and len(d['suite_results'])==6
for row in d['suite_results']:
 assert row['status']=='pass'and row['returncode']==0 and row['completion_marker_seen']and len(row['native_modules'])==4
 folder=Path(row['cwd'])
 for name,h in row['source_hashes'].items():assert sha(folder/name)==h,name
 for module in row['native_modules']:artifact(module['path'],module['sha256'])
 assert sha(folder/'libs/-lib2.so')==sha(folder/'libs/lib2.so')
 for flag in ['-m32','-msse2','-mfpmath=sse']:assert all(flag in module['command']for module in row['native_modules'])
checked=next(command for command in d['builds']if'-include'in command);assert all(flag in checked for flag in ['-m32','-msse2','-mfpmath=sse'])
header=Path(checked[checked.index('-include')+1]);assert '#define lua_assert(e)'in header.read_text()and'exit(86)'in header.read_text()
assert len(elfs)>=12
result=dict(report_sha256=sha(p),package_manifest_sha256=sha(mp),source_hashes_verified=True,artifact_hashes_verified=True,elf32_binaries=len(elfs),pointer_bits=32,observations=97,forwarded_entries=133,stock_suite_passes=6,no_external_lua_dependency=True,checked_reference_enabled=True,audit_script_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)))
(r/'docs/testing/2026-10-29-rust-lua-capi-i686-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print('Verified i686 standalone package, C ABI forwarding, native modules and all six stock-suite runs.')

limitations: lua_newstate/lua_getallocf/lua_setallocf remain absent; default states use the Rust allocator.
Exact heap/GC accounting, OOM behavior and general interleavings remain open.
Deep C callback tests reserve 32 MiB of host stack; PUC-equivalent stack/resource bounds are unproven.
